items.title: Show HN: Promptuaria – GitHub for specs
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I'm seeing more and more people sharing software specs instead of code, and I think this will become increasingly common as coding agents get better at one-shotting entire apps from a single prompt.
So I put together Promptuaria over a few days. It's a small platform where you can publish, version, and fork software specs, and link GitHub implementations to the exact spec versions they were built from so you can confront them.

items.title: Show HN: Vu – a new programming language designed for AI. Rust speeds, Py syntax
items.contentSnippet:
hi everyone! I wanted to share what I've been working on these past 6~ years.
TL;DR: Rust is great, but somewhere along the way, I learned that I was too dumb to read and write Rust. As I worked on larger and larger Rust projects, I also became frustrated with the developer experience of working in Rust (slow compile time), so I wanted a better way.
Vu's language changed a bit over time but the core principles remained the same:
1. It should be easy to read and write
2. It should be memory safe

items.title: Show HN: Fan of Sleep – a white noise fan you can play in the browser
items.contentSnippet:
Fan of Sleep is a white noise app (I can’t sleep without a fan running). I just redesigned it and rebuilt the site so you can use the fan right in your browser.
The wind and rain are the app’s own shaders ported to WebGL, and when the fan’s on it blows the page around a bit. No account, nothing to sign up for. Play around and have fun!
